content.text: This 7-day Meghalaya tour is ideal for individuals who enjoy visiting new areas and natural wonders. Shillong, Meghalaya's capital, has numerous beautiful and magnificent tourist attractions, including Ward's Lake, Lady Hydari Park, Shillong Golf Course, and the Don Bosco Museum, which reflect the local culture. You'll be seeing Cherrapunji, the world's wettest spot, with its beautiful waterfalls and tunnels. Trek to Nongriat to view the amazing Double Decker Root Bridge and the lush nature surrounding it. In Dawki, see the Indo-Bangladesh Border and the Umngot River, where you may swim. Enjoy boating on the crystal clear water, which allows you to view the riverbed. Visit Mawlynnong, Asia's cleanest hamlet, and see the incredible Balancing Rock and Living Root Bridge. Visit Jowai, which is known for its gorgeous waterfalls such as Krang Suri Falls, Tyrshi Falls, and the Nartiang Monoliths Garden. Enjoy a boat cruise on the Brahmaputra River in Guwahati.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Tour of the beautiful man-made Umiam Lake
Visit Shillong's stunning tourist attractions like Ward's Lake, Lady Hydari Park, and others
On the way to Cherrapunji, take in the breathtaking scenery of Mawkdok Valley and Elephant Falls
Witness the stunning waterfalls, caves and parks of Cherrapunji
Trek about 3500 to Nongriat to see the amazing Double Decker Root Bridge
A visit to Asia’s cleanest village, Mawlynnong
Travel to Dawki, a little border town between India and Bangladesh
Overnight camping in Shnongpdeng
In Jowai visit Krang Suri Falls, Tyrshi Falls and the beautiful Nartiang Monoliths Garden
Take a boat ride along the Brahmaputra River

main.title: Majestic Cherrapunji Dawki Mawlynnong Tour Itinerary

days.title: Day 1 : Guwahati Arrival- Shillong
items: You will be picked up from the Guwahati Airport or Railway Station by our representative.
Drive to Shillong, stopping along the way to see the picturesque Umiam Lake and Nehru Park.
Arrive in Shillong and check at your hotel.

days.title: Day 2 : Cherrapunji Sightseeing
items: Head to Cherrapunji after breakfast.
Visit Elephant Falls along the way and take in the breathtaking views of Mawkdok Dympep Valley.
Beautiful Nohkalikai Falls, Wei Sawdong Falls, and Seven Sister Falls are also on the itinerary.
Spend some time meandering through Cherrapunji's magnificent Eco Park.
Check into your hotel later.

days.title: Day 3 : Double Decker Root Bridge Trek
items: After a delectable breakfast, travel to Tyrna, the trek's beginning site.
Begin your walk by exploring the varied vegetation and plant varieties.
See the spectacular Double Decker Root Bridge after arriving at Nongriat.
Allow yourself to be refreshed by the cold water flowing beneath the bridge.
If you like, you may also hike to Rainbow Falls.
Return to Cherrapunji for an overnight stay later.

days.title: Day 4 : Mawlynnong-Dawki
items: Head to Mawlynnong after your delectable breakfast.
Visit Asia's cleanest community and learn about its cleanliness and sanitation system.
After that, travel to Dawki, a little town on the Indo-Bangladesh border.
Enjoy boating on the Umngot River's beautiful pure water.
In the evening, head to the Shnongpdeng riverbank campsite for a campfire that has been carefully prepared for you.

days.title: Day 5 : Jowai-Shillong
items: After breakfast, begin your journey to Jowai.
Krang Suri Falls, Tyrshi Falls, and the lovely Nartiang Monoliths Garden are also worth seeing.
Later, travel to Shillong and spend some quality shopping at the Shillong Bazar.
Check into your Shillong hotel for a peaceful night's sleep.

days.title: Day 6 : Shillong to Guwahati Tour
items: Get up and enjoy your delicious breakfast.
Visit Ward's Lake and the Shillong Golf Course to take in the scenery.
Drive to the Don Bosco Museum, which features Meghalayan culture.
Before evening, proceed to Guwahati.
Take a boat cruise along the magnificent Brahmaputra River.
After that, check into your Guwahati hotel.

days.title: Day 7 : End of your Tour
items: Drive to Guwahati Airport or Railway Station with all the wonderful recollections of your 7-day journey.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which are beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7(seven) business days in the customer’s bank account.
